subject: Model-type experiment class set up in experiments/model-types (EBM field probe live-verified)
result: New experiment class designed and set up under experiments/model-types/: separated cognitive faculties onto native model types instead of one autoregressive LLM miming every function. SPECIMENS RESEARCHED: EB-JEPA (facebookresearch/eb_jepa, Apache-2.0, arXiv:2602.03604, latent prediction + Two Rooms planning 97%); Jev (TypeSafe AI, typesafe-ai/jev via Vercel AI Gateway evaluation only, AI SDK 7 experimental_evaluate — verified real at ai@7.0.105; Boolean/Choice/Score with probabilities, one parallel pass); Mercury 2.5 (Inception Labs, OpenAI-compatible api.inceptionlabs.ai/v1, INCEPTION_API_KEY not present); GLM stays reflection faculty. All vendor performance claims recorded unverified in specimens.json. FIVE FILES OF DESIGN + TWO RUNNABLES: (E-MT-1) Jev typed typification of QL-MEF census — build_states.py builds masked-field prediction states + truth from the owner real labeled corpus (m-ledger dispositions 703/205/2973, census-m{1,2,3} implemented/partial/unimplemented); 600 states built and verified. (E-MT-2) loop decision refereeing — question-catalogue.json maps the five policy.rs decision points (ql-next-act, ql-propose-determination, classify_stipulations, deep depth, resolve_Rij) onto typed questions with state shapes; replay of retained series1 runs needs a decision-context exporter (first wiring task). harness.mjs fail-closed preflight verified (exit 3 without AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY, no fixture fallback; writes digest-pinned run records, determination always pending-human-review). (E-MT-EBM-FIELD) field_probe.py RAN LIVE against real graph bolt://100.92.62.101:7687: 2141 nodes, 11774 edges, 1378 distinct relation types. FINDINGS: (a) live graph materializes ZERO schema-declared POSk_* relation types — declared-vs-live vocabulary drift is a result in itself; (b) the field DOES separate real from corrupted pairs with even a fixture-grade lexical readout: separation AUC 0.592 (endpoint-rewire, different-position) and 0.559 (hard-rewire, same-position — signal beyond position classes); (c) type-shuffle and direction-reversal sit at exactly 0.5 because pair-level potentials are blind to type choice and direction — precisely the Phase-2 learned-head motivation; (d) no in-graph embeddings found — running bimba_embed batch then re-running the probe is the cheapest next upgrade. Evidence: ebm/evidence/field-probe-20260917-172854.json (digest-pinned, promotion none, reading class research). (E-MT-3, E-MT-4) jepa/ and hybrid-loop/ are design contracts: JEPA over the loop own event traces (toy volume today — 15 retained runs; volume comes from E-MT-4 runs), and the faculty-composed ql-faculty loop condition (Mercury generates, Jev referees, EBM gates, GLM reflects) running the same frozen series1 corpus under the same held-constant law as a fourth condition, with explicit falsification conditions and a 5-step implementation path through named seams only. RELATION TO PARALLEL LOOP WORK: rides it, does not fork — same corpus, same evidence law, ModelBody/RuntimeHost seams unchanged; suite-level ModelSurface registration (aikit.model-modality/v1) named as future work in specimens.json. HONEST LIMITS: no Rust code touched (policy.rs in-flight, steps 4-5 land via proposal on a branch); Jev and Mercury runs are credential-gated; jev node_modules installed locally and gitignored; nothing committed — new files sit uncommitted in the working tree on agent/land-held-session-returns-2026-09-17 alongside the two untracked NOW records. Follow-up agent: read experiments/model-types/README.md then the per-experiment READMEs, run ebm probe + jev build_states from those docs; to go live on Jev/Mercury supply AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY / INCEPTION_API_KEY; to wire E-MT-2 start from the decision-context exporter named in jev/question-catalogue.json state_shapes.
